sloka: स तं समासाद्य महानगेन्द्रमतिप्रवृद्धोत्तमघोरशृङ्गम्।ददर्श पुण्यानि महाश्रमाणि सुरर्षिसङ्घोत्तमसेवितानि ।। ६.७४.५८ ।।
transliteration: sa taṁ samāsādya mahānagendramatipravṛddhottamaghoraśṛṅgam।dadarśa puṇyāni mahāśramāṇi surarṣisaṅghottamasevitāni ।। 6.74.58 ।।

translations.english: He saw the seat of Brahma, the abode of Rajathanabha, the abode of Indra, the location from which Rudra discharged an arrow (at Tripura), the abode of Lord Hayagriva, and glowing abode of the deity presiding over Brahmastra and Vyvasvatah's attendants.
